passage.text:
The Remote Work Revolution

The rapid shift to remote work during the COVID-19 pandemic has fundamentally transformed how millions of people approach their jobs. What began as an emergency measure has evolved into a lasting change in work culture, with profound implications for employees, employers, cities, and society. While remote work offers numerous benefits, it also presents challenges that organizations and workers continue to navigate.
